output.reason: None of the approved units gives an out-of-network specialist copay. The copay units (E-CB-07 at $45, U-BEN-COST-001-07 and -09 at $35) cover only illustrative in-network examples, and they conflict with each other. The disclaimer (U-BEN-COST-001-02) only says costs can change when a provider is out of network, without giving an amount.
